name: The Skin You're In
source:
"Once upon a time, not too long ago, in a city quite like your own, a circus came to town..."
and that's when the trouble began.

Coppelia, a human-sized puppet and the star of the traveling Circus Reverie, fell in love with a human woman. Every night, she saw her in the audience, and soon, she could think of no one else. 

However, as much as Coppelia wanted to tell her Beloved how she felt,she knew it was impossible she would accept her feelings.

Because, after all…she was just a puppet.
  
 ‘Alas!’ She thought to herself,  ‘If only life were like the stories we performed on stage! If I had a fairy godmother, I could ask her to make me into a real girl...

I would do anything to be human!’

"Anything, you say...?"

[From [url=https://bluerosesonata.itch.io/the-skin-youre-in]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“从前，不久前，在一座像你们自己的城市里，有一个马戏团来到了镇上……”
这就是麻烦开始的时候。

葛蓓莉亚（Coppelia）是一个真人大小的木偶，也是巡回马戏团幻想曲的明星，她爱上了一个人类女人。每天晚上，她都会在观众席上看到她，很快，她就想不到其他人了。

然而，尽管科蓓莉亚很想告诉她的挚爱她的感受，她知道她不可能接受自己的感受。

因为，终究……她只是一个傀儡。
  
 “唉！”她心里想，“生活要是像我们在舞台上表演的故事就好了！”如果我有一个仙女教母，我可以请求她把我变成一个真正的女孩……

为了成为人类，我愿意做任何事情！

“有什么，你说……？”
